assertions.detail: An empty install tree created a fresh client profile and initialized userData without inheriting predecessor conversation state.
Conversation state and helper identity remained readable from the same userData directory after replacing the versioned install tree.
A predecessor-version launch classified the atomic updater intent as interrupted, removed the marker once, and retained conversation state.
Removing the owned install tree left the documented retained userData conversation state readable.

limitations: This is a real temporary-filesystem seam test, not an OS installer execution receipt.
This is a real temporary-filesystem seam test, not an OS installer execution receipt or signed cross-platform lifecycle run.
